items.name: crystal-flower-crown
items.designBrief: A delicate cool ivory-silver and jade floral crown with a central diamond gem, three graceful linked pearl/crystal arches and dangling loops. Preserve the source's intricate arched jewelry silhouette, omit floating blue circle/rainbow.

items.name: princess-jade-tiara
items.designBrief: Small open filigree princess tiara, symmetric low side wings and a tall clear central crystal above one oval cinnabar-red jewel. Ivory-gold framework with tiny jade details.

items.name: star-empress-diadem
items.designBrief: A distinct tall formal diadem: center oval moonstone medallion beneath a small pointed crest, two elongated curled side spires, open lattice and squared jewel foot band. Jade/ivory with fine warm gold, no copied emblem.

items.name: rose-hairpin
items.designBrief: A single lush deep rose-pink flower hair ornament with layered rounded petals and two small jade-green leaves. Standalone flower, no face or long stem.

items.name: jade-dragon-crown
items.designBrief: Original frontal friendly dragon-face ceremonial crown: sweeping golden antler-like rays, round stylized dragon snout at center and a row of short hanging jewel plaques. Own Daoist shape, jade accents, not source movie/QQ identity.

items.name: golden-flame-crest
items.designBrief: Symmetric gold flame-wing crest/circlet, central circular sun-jade medallion, rising middle flame and two hooked outer wings. Keep distinct from the dragon crown, no dragon face.
